introduction: A wet floor dries without boiling. Evaporation explains how energetic surface molecules escape as vapour.
slos: Explain why evaporation occurs at a liquid surface.
previousKnowledge: Adding or removing energy changes molecular motion and may change the physical state of matter.

slides.title: Evaporation is a surface process
slides.lead: Some surface molecules have enough energy to escape into the air as vapour.
bullets: Does not require the whole liquid to boil

slides.title: Quick check
bullets: Why does wind speed up evaporation?
Why does sweating cool the body?
slides.answer: Wind removes vapour from the surface; evaporating sweat carries heat away.

recap: Evaporation occurs at the liquid surface.
Its rate depends on environmental and liquid factors.
reviewQuestions: Why does water evaporate faster from a wide dish?
nextLectureBridge: The next lecture applies evaporation and condensation to refrigeration and introduces latent heat.
